_note: Input to tools/build-decks.mjs. The decks themselves are generated from
data/vocab, data/kanji and data/sentences, so a deck can never contain a
word the corpus does not contain.
Card identity is noteId + ':' + templateId (CONTRACTS C4.2 rule 1). The note
id is derived from the source item id, which is derived from the selection
order, so re-running this script on the same corpus produces the same ids.
That is the whole point: the ledger's foreign key is that string, and an id
that moves discards a person's study history.
Each deck is written twice, once under books/japanese/decks/ for the
Runcible chapter that uses it and once under rappel-site/data/decks/ for
Rappel's own library. Same generator, so they cannot drift, and the build
cmp's the two files rather than only asserting it in a comment.
A row marked held is not rebuilt. Commit 5124bee corrected those four decks
by editing the output rather than this generator, so a re-run would throw the
teacher panel's work away; the deck under books/ is the document, the build
copies it to Rappel and counts its catalog row from the file. Folding those
three edits into build-decks.mjs and dropping the flag is the real fix.
A row's optional escape lists codepoints the writer emits as \uXXXX rather
than as themselves. It is set on one row, and the reason is in writeData in
tools/lib/corpus.mjs: one character of KANJIDIC's grade 2 list is also the
whole title of a banned song, so a deck built over that slice would be a hit
for check-licence.mjs. The parsed value is identical either way.
